source_policy: Only OPM and federal .gov sources are used. Counts are public OPM Federal Workforce Data employment rows, not VA facility staffing rosters.

snapshot.count_field_note: In this VA extract, OPM's count field is 1 on every VA row, so visible row count equals visible public-duty-station employee count.

foreign_base.label: Foreign area - no GS locality pay
foreign_base.note: OPM states GS employees in foreign areas are not eligible for locality pay. This lab does not calculate foreign allowances, post differentials, danger pay, special rates, Title 38 rates, or agency payroll determinations.

rus_territory.label: Rest of U.S. and territories
rus_territory.note: OPM lists Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, Guam and CNMI, and Other Possessions with 17.06 percent locality in 2026, while separate nonforeign COLA percentages may also apply.

alaska.label: Alaska
alaska.note: OPM lists Alaska at 32.36 percent locality in 2026 with separate nonforeign COLA rows and GS-15 cap caveats.

hawaii.label: Hawaii
hawaii.note: OPM lists Hawaii at 22.21 percent locality in 2026 with separate nonforeign COLA rows and GS-15 cap caveats.

locations.name: Manila VA Clinic
locations.count_note: VA.gov identifies Manila as a VA clinic in the Philippines, but the public OPM June 2026 VA employment file has no visible Manila, Pasay, Philippines, or Philippine duty-station rows. The count is therefore not asserted here; OPM redacts 5,834 VA duty-station rows in this release.

locations.name: Named foreign VA rows
locations.display_location: Foreign duty stations visible by country
locations.count_note: Visible named foreign VA rows in the OPM public file exclude redacted rows and do not include a visible Manila/Pasay/Philippines row.
